g.text: Two contractions keep the native seam between them
Its original section homotopy is part of the full comparison
X ⇄ B ⇄ Y
p̂ = p̂₂ p̂₁ ĥ = ĥ₁ + i₁ ĥ₂ p̂₁
κ̂_B i₂ − i′₂ κ̂_Y = δR̂
All maps retain their full joint parameter bar.
The sections need not commute strictly with the original seam.
Move that seam with its actual full homotopy
U = p̂′₂ κ̂_B p̂₁ V = κ̂_Y p̂₂ p̂₁
Ê = (p̂′₂ κ̂_B ĥ₂ + p̂′₂ R̂ p̂₂) p̂₁
δÊ = U − V
Object maps agree on y; still Ê(y) = z.
At sE_yy ⊗ y: U − V = −z
Deleting the R̂ term leaves the chain defect +z.
The original two-seam coherence also survives
δω = ηθ − ζ
δ(C_η,θ + K_ω) = K_ζ − B_η K_θ − K_η A_θ + L_ω
On v: C_η,θ = 6z K_ω = −z
Whole comparison: 5z derivative on u: −5z
Omitting the original K_ω gives defect −z.
Full staged contractions, seam sliding and two-seam boundaries: Theorem 41.
All original operators, section terms and unary differentials: Exercise 41.
Free bar-module background: Keller, arXiv:math/9910179, §4.2.
